document_title: Air India: Citizen's Charter and General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: Air India: Citizen's Charter and General Conditions of Carriage for Passen
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: Air India: Citizen's Charter and General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage PUBLISHER: Air India Limited (Tata Group) REGULATOR/AIRLINE: DGCA / Air India REGION: India / Global OFFICIAL URL: https://www.airindia.com/in/en/travel-information/citizen-charter.html EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-03-01 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text AIR INDIA (TATA GROUP) CITIZEN'S CHARTER & CARRIAGE CONDITIONS 1. DELAYS & CANCELLATIONS: - Air India provides free meals and refreshments for flight delays exceeding 2 hours for flights up to 2.5 hours, and 3 hours for flights between 2.5 and 5 hours. - If delay exceeds 24 hours or domestic flight delayed > 6 hours departing between 20:00 and 03:00 hrs: Free hotel accommodation with airport transfers. - Involuntary cancellations: Passengers are offered choice of immediate rebooking on next Air India flight, transfer to partner airlines under interline agreements, or full refund to original payment method. 2. BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE (DOMESTIC & INTERNATIONAL): - Domestic Economy (Comfort/Comfort Plus): 15 kg - 20 kg free checked baggage depending on fare brand. Flex fares include 25 kg. - Domestic Business Class: 35 kg free checked baggage. - Hand Baggage: Economy 7 kg (1 piece); Business 12 kg (1 piece) plus small personal item. - Excess Baggage: Domestic excess baggage charged at INR 600 per kg at airport counter (prepaid discounts available online). 3. SPECIAL ASSISTANCE: - Free wheelchair assistance for PRMs, elderly, and medical cases from kerbside to aircraft seat. - Stretcher and medical oxygen facilities available upon 48-hour prior notification with MEDIF clearance. 4. MERGED VISTARA - AIR INDIA POLICY ALIGNMENT: - Club Vistara and Flying Returns consolidated under Maharaja Club. - Ticket changes on merged routes follow Air India fare rules; rebooking protections honored reciprocally.

document_title: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV: Facilities to be Provided to Passengers by Airlines Due to Denied Boarding, Cancellation of Flights and Delays in Flights
publisher: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) India
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV: Facilities to be Provided to Passenge
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV: Facilities to be Provided to Passengers by Airlines Due to Denied Boarding, Cancellation of Flights and Delays in Flights PUBLISHER: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) India REGULATOR/AIRLINE: DGCA REGION: India OFFICIAL URL: https://www.dgca.gov.in/digigov-portal/Upload?flag=iframeAttachView&attachId=150616198 EFFECTIVE DATE: 2023-05-18 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text DGCA CIVIL AVIATION REQUIREMENTS (CAR) SECTION 3 - AIR TRANSPORT SERIES 'M' PART IV (REVISED ISSUE I) FACILITIES TO BE PROVIDED TO PASSENGERS BY AIRLINES DUE TO DENIED BOARDING, CANCELLATION OF FLIGHTS AND DELAYS IN FLIGHTS. 1. DENIED BOARDING (OVERBOOKING): - When an airline expects to deny boarding due to overbooking, it shall first call for volunteers to surrender seats in exchange for benefits. - If involuntary denied boarding occurs, the airline shall compensate the passenger: a) Block time <= 1 hr: 200% of one-way basic fare + airline fuel charge, up to INR 10,000, if alternative flight provided within 1 hr. b) Block time > 1 hr and up to 2 hrs: 300% of one-way basic fare + fuel charge, up to INR 15,000. c) Block time > 2 hrs or if alternate flight offered after 24 hrs: 400% of one-way basic fare + fuel charge, up to INR 20,000. d) If passenger does not opt for alternate flight: Full refund of ticket + 400% of one-way basic fare + fuel charge up to INR 20,000. 2. CANCELLATION OF FLIGHTS: - Airlines must inform passengers of cancellation at least 2 weeks in advance and offer alternate flight or full refund. - If informed less than 2 weeks and up to 24 hours before scheduled departure, airline must arrange alternate flight departing within 2 hours of original time or refund the ticket. - If passengers are not informed or miss connecting flight on same PNR due to cancellation: a) Alternate flight or refund as per passenger choice; AND b) Compensation: - Flights with block time up to 1 hr: INR 5,000 or booked one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, whichever is less. - Flights with block time > 1 hr and up to 2 hrs: INR 7,500 or booked basic fare plus fuel charge, whichever is less. - Flights with block time > 2 hrs: INR 10,000 or booked basic fare plus fuel charge, whichever is less. - No compensation is payable if cancellation is caused by Extraordinary Circumstances (force majeure, meteorological conditions, ATC instructions, political instability, security risks).

FLIGHT DELAYS: - For flight delays beyond scheduled departure time: a) Delay >= 2 hours (for flights with block time up to 2.5 hours): Free meals and refreshments commensurate with waiting time. b) Delay >= 3 hours (for flights with block time between 2.5 and 5 hours): Free meals and refreshments. c) Delay >= 4 hours (for all other flights): Free meals and refreshments. d) Delay > 24 hours or domestic flight delayed > 6 hours (scheduled between 20:00 and 03:00 hrs): Airline must provide free hotel accommodation including transfers. - For delay >= 5 hours: Passengers have option to cancel ticket and receive full refund without any cancellation fee. 4. BAGGAGE LOSS & DAMAGE: - If checked baggage is lost, delayed or damaged, liability is governed by Carriage by Air Act 1972: INR 20,000 per passenger for domestic flights or actual damage proven. - Immediate provisional compensation for delayed baggage essentials: INR 2,000-3,000 if delayed > 24 hours away from residence.

document_title: Ministry of Civil Aviation & DGCA Passenger Charter of Rights
publisher: Ministry of Civil Aviation / DGCA India
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: Ministry of Civil Aviation & DGCA Passenger Charter of Rights PUBLISHER: M
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: Ministry of Civil Aviation & DGCA Passenger Charter of Rights PUBLISHER: Ministry of Civil Aviation / DGCA India REGULATOR/AIRLINE: DGCA / MoCA REGION: India OFFICIAL URL: https://www.civilaviation.gov.in/sites/default/files/Passenger_Charter_Final.pdf EFFECTIVE DATE: 2021-02-27 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text MINISTRY OF CIVIL AVIATION - PASSENGER CHARTER OF RIGHTS (INDIA) 1. TICKET BOOKING & CANCELLATION: - Zero cancellation charge if ticket cancelled or amended within 24 hours of booking, provided flight departure is at least 7 days away. - Airlines cannot levy cancellation fee greater than the basic fare plus fuel surcharge. All statutory taxes and airport development fees (UDF/PSF) must be refunded 100% in all cases without penalty. - Name correction: Corrections in misspelled names up to 3 characters must be corrected by airlines free of charge within 24 hours of booking. 2. FLIGHT DELAYS & CANCELLATIONS: - In case of flight delay > 4 hours or flight cancellation: Passengers are entitled to free meal/refreshments, option of full refund or free rebooking on the next available flight of the same airline or partner carrier. - In case of flight delay > 6 hours departing between 8 PM and 3 AM: Airline must offer free hotel room with transfers. - In case of denied boarding: 300% to 400% of basic fare + fuel surcharge up to INR 20,000 plus alternate flight or full refund. 3. SPECIAL ASSISTANCE & ACCESSIBILITY: - Wheelchairs and assistance for Persons with Reduced Mobility (PRM) must be provided free of charge from terminal entrance to aircraft seat. - Service animals accompanying passengers with disabilities must be accommodated in cabin free of charge as per safety guidelines. 4. BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE & COMPENSATION: - Standard free domestic baggage: Minimum 15 kg checked baggage on scheduled flights (except Air India economy offering 20-25 kg depending on ticket class). - Free hand baggage: 1 piece up to 7 kg + 1 small personal item (laptop bag/purse). - Lost/delayed baggage claim window: Complaint must be lodged within 7 days for damage, 21 days for delay.

document_title: Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council: Common Rules on Compensation and Assistance to Passengers in the Event of Denied Boarding and of Cancellation or Long Delay of Flights
publisher: Official Journal of the European Union / EUR-Lex
airline: All EU Carriers & Flights Departing EU
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council:
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council: Common Rules on Compensation and Assistance to Passengers in the Event of Denied Boarding and of Cancellation or Long Delay of Flights PUBLISHER: Official Journal of the European Union / EUR-Lex REGULATOR/AIRLINE: European Commission REGION: European Union OFFICIAL URL: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32004R0261 EFFECTIVE DATE: 2005-02-17 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text EUROPEAN UNION REGULATION (EC) NO 261/2004 - PASSENGER RIGHTS DIRECTIVE 1. SCOPE OF APPLICATION: - Applies to all flights departing from an EU/EEA/UK airport (any airline). - Applies to all flights arriving at an EU/EEA/UK airport operated by an EU/UK licensed air carrier. 2. FLIGHT DELAYS (STURGEON JUDGMENT ECJ RECOGNIZED): - If flight arrives at final destination with delay >= 3 hours, passengers are entitled to fixed statutory compensation unless caused by extraordinary circumstances: a) Type 1 (Flights <= 1,500 km): EUR 250 per passenger. b) Type 2 (Intra-EU flights > 1,500 km, or other flights between 1,500 km and 3,500 km): EUR 400 per passenger. c) Type 3 (All other flights > 3,500 km): EUR 600 per passenger. - Right to Care: - Delay >= 2 hours (<=1500km), 3 hours (1500-3500km), or 4 hours (>3500km): Free meals, refreshments, 2 phone calls/emails. - Delay requiring overnight stay: Free hotel accommodation and transport. - Delay >= 5 hours: Right to abandon journey and receive 100% full refund within 7 days, plus free return flight to original departure point. 3. FLIGHT CANCELLATIONS: - Right to compensation (EUR 250 / EUR 400 / EUR 600) unless: a) Informed at least 2 weeks before scheduled departure time; OR b) Informed between 2 weeks and 7 days, and offered re-routing departing <= 2h before and arriving < 4h after scheduled arrival; OR c) Informed < 7 days, and offered re-routing departing <= 1h before and arriving < 2h after scheduled arrival; OR d) Airline proves cancellation was caused by Extraordinary Circumstances (severe weather, ATC strike, safety threat, closure of airspace). Technical faults are generally NOT extraordinary circumstances. 4. DENIED BOARDING (OVERBOOKING): - Immediate compensation of EUR 250 / EUR 400 / EUR 600. - Choice between: a) Full reimbursement within 7 days; OR b) Re-routing to final destination under comparable transport conditions at the earliest opportunity; OR c) Re-routing at a later date at passenger's convenience subject to seat availability.

document_title: IndiGo Airlines: Conditions of Carriage, Plan B, Cancellation and Baggage Regulations
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: IndiGo Airlines: Conditions of Carriage, Plan B, Cancellation and Baggage
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: IndiGo Airlines: Conditions of Carriage, Plan B, Cancellation and Baggage Regulations PUBLISHER: InterGlobe Aviation Limited (IndiGo) REGULATOR/AIRLINE: DGCA / IndiGo REGION: India / International OFFICIAL URL: https://www.goindigo.in/information/conditions-of-carriage.html EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-01-01 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text INDIGO AIRLINES (INTERGLOBE AVIATION) CONDITIONS OF CARRIAGE & POLICIES 1. INDIGO 'PLAN B' FOR DELAYS AND CANCELLATIONS: - If an IndiGo flight is cancelled or rescheduled by > 2 hours (for domestic flights) or > 2.5 hours (for international flights): a) Free Rebooking: Customer may rebook on an alternate IndiGo flight within +/- 14 days of original flight date at zero extra charge. b) Full Refund: Customer can cancel booking online through Plan B portal and receive a 100% refund without cancellation fee. 2. BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE: - Domestic Economy: Free allowance is 15 kg (1 piece). Additional baggage charged at standard excess rate (approx INR 550/kg or pre-booked prepaid slab rates: 5kg=INR 2,250, 10kg=INR 4,500). - Hand Baggage: 1 piece up to 7 kg (dimensions max 115 cm) + 1 small purse/laptop bag up to 3 kg. - Musical instruments, sports equipment and oversize baggage require Special Baggage Fee (INR 1,200 - 2,000). 3. NAME CHANGE & CORRECTION: - Name change to another person is NOT permitted. - Typographical error correction: Up to 3 characters in the first/last name can be corrected free of charge by contacting customer care with valid government photo ID. 4. CANCELLATION CHARGES: - Domestic flight cancelled > 3 days before departure: INR 3,000 or airfare charges (whichever is lower). - Domestic flight cancelled within 0-3 days: INR 3,500 or airfare charges. - Taxes (UDF, PSF, GST) are always 100% refunded.

document_title: IATA & Montreal Convention 1999: International Air Carrier Liability and Passenger Rights Limits
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: IATA & Montreal Convention 1999: International Air Carrier Liability and P
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: IATA & Montreal Convention 1999: International Air Carrier Liability and Passenger Rights Limits PUBLISHER: International Air Transport Association (IATA) / ICAO REGULATOR/AIRLINE: ICAO / IATA REGION: International OFFICIAL URL: https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/passenger-rights/ EFFECTIVE DATE: 2019-12-28 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text MONTREAL CONVENTION 1999 (MC99) & IATA PASSENGER RIGHTS LIABILITIES 1. SPECIAL DRAWING RIGHTS (SDR) STATUTORY LIABILITY LIMITS: - Flight Delay Liability: Up to 5,346 SDR per passenger (approx USD 7,100 / EUR 6,600 / INR 5,90,000) for proven economic loss caused by delay in the international carriage of persons. - Baggage Destruction, Loss, Damage, or Delay: Up to 1,288 SDR per passenger (revised 2019 to approx USD 1,720 / EUR 1,600 / INR 1,45,000) unless passenger made a special declaration of interest and paid supplementary fee. - Cargo Liability: 22 SDR per kilogram. 2. DEFENSE OF CARRIER: - Carrier is not liable for damage occasioned by delay if it proves that it and its servants took all measures that could reasonably be required to avoid the damage or that it was impossible to take such measures (force majeure, extraordinary circumstances). 3. NOTICE AND CLAIM WINDOWS: - Damage to checked baggage: Must be filed in writing immediately after discovery, at the latest within 7 days from receipt. - Delay of checked baggage: Must be filed in writing within 21 days from the date the baggage was placed at passenger disposal. - Extinction of rights: Legal action must be brought within 2 years from the date of arrival at destination.

document_title: US Department of Transportation 14 CFR Part 260: Refunds and Other Consumer Protections for Airline Passengers (2024 Final Rule)
airline: All US Carriers & Foreign Flights To/From USA
section_title: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: US Department of Transportation 14 CFR Part 260: Refunds and Other Consume
text: OFFICIAL POLICY DOCUMENT: US Department of Transportation 14 CFR Part 260: Refunds and Other Consumer Protections for Airline Passengers (2024 Final Rule) PUBLISHER: US Department of Transportation (DOT) REGULATOR/AIRLINE: US DOT REGION: United States OFFICIAL URL: https://www.transportation.gov/airconsumer/refunds EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-04-24 VERIFIED SOURCE STATUS: Seed Official Text US DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION (DOT) 14 CFR PART 260 & PASSENGER RIGHTS RULE 1. AUTOMATIC CASH REFUNDS MANDATE (EFFECTIVE 2024): - Airlines must issue prompt, automatic cash or original form of payment refunds (not vouchers or travel credits) when flights are cancelled or significantly changed, and passenger rejects alternate transportation. - 'Significant Change' defined explicitly by federal law: a) Departure or arrival time changes by > 3 hours for domestic flights. b) Departure or arrival time changes by > 6 hours for international flights. c) Departure or arrival airport changes. d) Increase in the number of connection points / layovers. e) Downgrade to a lower class of service. f) Connecting aircraft changes that are less accessible for passengers with disabilities. - Refund Timeline: - Within 7 business days if paid by credit card. - Within 20 calendar days if paid by cash, check, or debit. 2. BAGGAGE FEE REFUNDS: - If checked bag is not delivered within 12 hours of domestic arrival, or within 15-30 hours of international arrival (depending on flight duration), airline must automatically refund the checked baggage fee. 3. ANCILLARY SERVICE REFUNDS: - If passenger paid for Wi-Fi, seat selection, in-flight entertainment, or priority boarding and the service was not provided, full automatic refund of the fee is mandatory. 4. OVERBOOKING & BUMPING (14 CFR PART 250): - If involuntarily bumped from an oversold flight: - Delay <= 2 hours (domestic) or <= 4 hours (international): 200% of one-way fare up to USD 775. - Delay > 2 hours (domestic) or > 4 hours (international): 400% of one-way fare up to USD 1,550. - Passenger keeps original ticket and may request cash/check rather than airline vouchers.
